FULL TEXT:
EX-CADRE ASSISTANT RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2026
NOTICE
No.- 76/R&A Dated: 22nd September, 2026
This is for information to all concerned that computer based Preliminary Test
under the Ex-Cadre Assistant Recruitment Examination, 2026 (Advertisement No.
PHC/03/2026) was held on 18.09.2026 (Friday) in two shifts at 19 examination centres
situated at Patna & Muzaffarpur.
The link to view Model Answer alongwith Candidates’ Response of the Multiple
Choice Questions is being uploaded on the official website of the High Court i.e.
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/notices/recruitments which shall remain active from
24.09.2026 (11:00 a.m.) to 01.10.2026 (10:59 a.m.). Candidates who have appeared in the
aforesaid test may login through the provided link and click the ‘Model Answer-cum-
Candidate’s Response’ tab for viewing the model answer alongwith their respective answers
submitted in the test.
A candidate, who has appeared in this examination and wishes to raise an objection
regarding any question and/or the Model Answer, may submit an objection through the link
available on the official website of the High Court. The objection must be supported by a
copy of authentic source document(s)/proof on the basis of which it is being submitted.
Candidates shall be required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹50/- (Rupees Fifty
only) per objection raised, through online mode.
Any objection received without any authentic proof/source and/or the prescribed fee
and after the stipulated time or through any other mode than the one as prescribed in this
notice shall not be entertained/considered on any ground whatsoever and shall stand
rejected automatically without assigning any reason.
The Model Answer shall be finalized after considering the valid objections received
and the same shall be used as Final Model Answer for generating the result of the
P a g e | 2
Preliminary Test under Ex-Cadre Assistant Recruitment Examination, 2026. No
representation regarding any question or the final Model Answer shall be entertained after
the closing date for submission of objections and any such representation shall stand
rejected without assigning any reason. In the event of non-receipt of any objection, the
Model Answer published herewith shall be deemed final and the result shall be generated
accordingly.
The decision of the High Court of Judicature at Patna on the objections shall be
final and no further correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further
details/updates
By order
Sd/- Rupesh Deo
Registrar General
